$comment: Design tokens. Derived from the character art. Owned by the project lead. Every agent reads this; none edits it. An agent needing a value not listed proposes the addition and stops.

$rules: There is no error colour. Nothing in this product reads as an error.
A wrong tap gets a line of dialogue, never a red flash or a shake.
The characters carry all the colour. The board is warm and neutral so Rhino and Pip stay the only saturated things on screen.
pip blue is the single accent. Do not introduce a second saturated colour.

body.$comment: Lexend was designed to improve reading performance in children. Do not substitute.

$rules: Body text never below 1rem. These are beginner readers.
Sentence case everywhere. No all-caps labels.
The prompt is the largest text on the chapter screen.

touch.$comment: Roughly double the adult minimum. Ages 6-8 have developing fine motor control. This is a floor, not a target.

$rules: Motion answers an action. A piece moving, a chapter opening, a celebration firing.
No ambient motion, no scroll-triggered fades, no hover effects on everything.
prefers-reduced-motion must be respected. Reduce to instant; never remove the feedback.
Square colours derive from board.size. Never hardcode a grid.
Legal destinations on empty squares: a filled dot.
Legal destinations on capturable pieces: a ring around the square.
This affordance is the most important teaching element in the product. It is never subtle.

character.$comment: One canvas for both characters so the size relationship is baked into the art. Pip is 51% of Rhino, measured from the reference. Every pose shares a baseline.

quality.responsive: tablet and desktop equally; must not break on mobile
